title: Lexical retrieval
text: Sparse retrieval indexes words. BM25 ranks passages using term frequency and document length.

title: Dense retrieval
text: Dense retrieval embeds queries and passages. Semantic similarity can bridge a vocabulary mismatch.

title: Rank fusion
text: Reciprocal rank fusion combines lexical and dense rankings. Fusion does not require equal score scales.

title: Reranking
text: A cross encoder reranks candidate passages. A reranker cannot recover evidence excluded by retrieval.

title: Chunk boundaries
text: Paragraph boundaries preserve context. Oversized paragraphs require deterministic splitting without overlap.

title: Evaluation
text: Recall measures known relevant results. Judgment coverage describes how many returned passages were assessed.

title: Repeated positions
text: red red blue red. red blue blue. A phrase needs consecutive positions in one chunk.

title: Case and punctuation
text: RAG-based BM25: don't discard stopwords! AND and Or or NOT not.

title: Unicode text
text: CAFÉ café café Straße İSTANBUL ΣΟΣ 中文１２３ ² Ⅳ. Unicode distinctions stay visible.

title: Collection scope
text: Private collections require authorization. Negation is relative to the currently loaded collection.

title: Reproducibility
text: Stable hashes identify source versions. Snapshot identities exclude timestamps and input ordering.

title: Unrelated astronomy
text: Stars form inside cold molecular clouds. Orbital periods and telescope optics concern astronomy.
